author: Claude (Joystick session)
summary: Consolidated Treasury Game Shark (TGS) contract references from three versions (v5, v7, v8) down to TGSv8 only. Removed dead code paths from the active runtime codebase while archiving legacy scripts and preserving all data files (ABIs, addresses, recon snapshots) for future reference.

TGSv5.purpose: WM batch minter — calls WM.RHO() N times via mintWM(count). Single-purpose: no token factory, no DEX, no swap.

TGSv7.purpose: Token Factory — createV4, createV3, mintTokens, claimTokens, deposit/withdraw, single DEX router. Did NOT include mintWM (required TGSv5 as external dependency).
TGSv7.superseded_by: TGSv8 (all v7 functions + mintWM + dual DEX)

TGSv8.purpose: Complete execution layer: Token Factory + WM batch minting + Dual DEX (V1+V2) + atomicArb + swapNativeForTokens + getReservesBoth. Self-contained — no external TGS dependency.

removed_from_runtime.reason: No active code imports these. ABIs kept on disk at data/abis/tgsv5.json and data/abis/tgsv7.json.
